title: Replacing a retained observer while its old call is pending must route new calls correctly
reason: Reviewed non-promoting characterization/design; excluded from the 461 assertion-bearing case credit; source retained.

contract.intent: Replacing a retained observer while its old call is pending must route new calls correctly
preconditions: Old callback local barrier closed; distinct replacement callback
trace: Retain old and observe entry of held emit
Replace slot with new and release original old
Complete new emit before releasing old local gate
Release old gate; require old result and separate final disposals
contract.failure_schedule: Explicit named gate is released only after observed entry; no time-based race; at most one injected failure when the trace names it
contract.stress: Subscription replacement during an active reverse RPC
contract.oracle: Old in-flight operation finishes; later dispatch reaches only new callback
contract.cleanup: Release all local and provider barriers, remove retained and borrowed handles, await tracked calls, dispose every owned handle in reverse order, verify local callback cohort counts and provider created/disposed equality, then delete per-case state. Supervisor tears down owned fleet after timeout or unknown cleanup.
contract.distinctness: Literal O021 state transition; counts, repetitions and deployment placements do not create additional cases.
